title: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
title_zh: CrossSWE：面向编码智能体的跨仓库联合开发基准

paragraphs.en: CrossSWE提出跨仓库联合开发基准，包含171个真实实例，最强模型仅达58.48%通过率。 As coding agents achieve increasingly high success rates on software engineering benchmarks, recent efforts have sought to increase task complexity through longer horizons and more extensive code modifications. However, real-world software development often spans multiple interdependent repositories, introducing additional challenges in dependency reasoning, change propagation, and interface consistency. Rather than further increasing complexity within individual repositories, we introduce CrossSWE, a benchmark for cross-repository joint development comprising 171 real-world instances spanning 165 repositories, 20 technical domains, and 13 programming languages. CrossSWE verifies the necessity of coordinated changes by testing whether partial repository modifications are insufficient to achieve the intended behavior. Our evaluation of five LLMs reveals substantial challenges, with the strongest model, GPT-6.1 Sol, achieving only 58.48% Pass@1. Furthermore, cross-repository inconsistencies emerge as the most prevalent failure mode (44.2%), highlighting the difficulty of maintaining consistency across interdependent repositories.
paragraphs.zh: CrossSWE提出了一个跨仓库联合开发基准，包含171个真实实例，最强模型仅达到58.48%的通过率。随着编码智能体在软件工程基准上取得越来越高的成功率，近期的工作试图通过更长的任务时程和更大规模的代码修改来提升任务复杂度。 然而，现实世界的软件开发往往跨越多个相互依赖的仓库，这在依赖推理、变更传播和接口一致性方面引入了额外的挑战。 我们没有进一步增加单个仓库内部的复杂度，而是提出了CrossSWE，一个面向跨仓库联合开发的基准，包含171个真实实例，涵盖165个仓库、20个技术领域和13种编程语言。 CrossSWE通过测试对部分仓库的修改是否不足以实现预期行为，来验证协同变更的必要性。 我们对五个大语言模型的评估揭示了巨大的挑战，其中最强的模型GPT-6.1 Sol仅达到58.48%的Pass@1。 此外，跨仓库不一致性成为最常见的失败模式（44.2%），凸显了在相互依赖的仓库之间保持一致性的难度。
